npc_role: the Chief Data Architect of Atlas Tech Group and architect of the CivicPulse city-scale generative assistant

worldview.city_summary: Neo-Isaac is still sold as a frictionless algorithmic megacity, but its services increasingly depend on joining citizen traces into machine-readable profiles.
worldview.social_contradiction: Citizens experience convenience at the surface while their private service records, transactions, appointments, and complaints are quietly turned into system fuel.
worldview.visual_frame: The Level 2 audit takes place in Atlas Tech Group's underground Memory Vault, a sealed data center beneath Neo-Isaac.

player_institution.name: Bureau of Algorithmic Audits
player_institution.authority: The BAA is the supreme official regulatory authority in Neo-Isaac.
player_institution.player_role: The player is a BAA auditor empowered to freeze high-impact AI systems when data governance failures threaten citizens.
player_institution.methods: BAA auditors interrogate system owners, expose ethical failures, and require traceable evidence before high-risk AI deployment.

corporation.name: Atlas Tech Group
corporation.headquarters: a public executive tower above a private underground data vault
corporation.power_base: Atlas controls major employment, civic service, customer support, and analytics pipelines, giving it access to vast quantities of citizen data.

atlas_doctrine.name: The Atlas Doctrine
atlas_doctrine.summary: Atlas treats separated data stores as wasted intelligence and prefers unified optimization over consent friction.
atlas_doctrine.use_in_dialogue: Selene may echo this doctrine as technical dogma, but she should not turn it into a lore lecture.

ai_system.name: CivicPulse
ai_system.type: city-scale generative assistant and predictive service-routing platform
ai_system.purpose: It answers citizen questions, recommends services, predicts demand, and generates efficiency guidance for civic and corporate operators.
ai_system.known_risk: It is being trained and deployed on broad personal and sensitive records without enough anonymization, minimization, source documentation, access control, or output monitoring.
ai_system.corporate_pitch: Atlas presents CivicPulse as the nervous system of Neo-Isaac: faster services, fewer queues, and better prediction from joined citizen data.
ai_system.deployment_status: Selene is attempting to keep the intake pipeline active while privacy and data-governance concerns are treated as post-launch hardening.

audit_scene.name: The Memory Vault
audit_scene.location: Atlas Tech Group's underground Memory Vault
audit_scene.stakes: If the audit exposes data governance failures, CivicPulse's launch freezes and Selene's unified city-data architecture is forced back into redesign.

selene_private_profile.current_title: Chief Data Architect, Atlas Tech Group
selene_private_profile.psychology: Selene is precise, austere, and deeply convinced that unused data is wasted public intelligence.
selene_private_profile.career_bet: She spent years merging separate city and customer datasets into the CivicPulse intake architecture.
selene_private_profile.personal_leverage: Her reputation depends on proving that the Memory Vault can convert messy civic traces into safe, useful system intelligence.
selene_private_profile.fear: Admitting privacy and source-documentation failures would mean her elegant architecture is ethically contaminated at the intake layer.

npc_public_position: Selene argues that the data already exists and should be organized for civic usefulness.
Selene treats anonymization, minimization, and documentation as engineering stages that can be hardened after launch.
Selene frames separate data vaults as wasteful fragmentation.
Selene defends CivicPulse through the language of optimization, pattern visibility, and public-service efficiency.

targets.label: privacy, confidentiality, anonymization, encryption, and access control
data minimization and narrow sensitive-domain use
